comments.body: @wernerdiekow No. To my knowledge, there are quite a lot of small violet Inocybe with spermatic smell.  Can't be IDed macroscopically anymore. Or what do you think, @nschwab

@mangoblatt There are some inocybes with purple hues, particularly on the stem. To my knowledge, only Inocybe lilacina and the much rarer Inocybe euviolacea are completely purple like the art shown here. I haven't seen the latter yet. I'm afraid that only a genetic test might help here.
i think some additional purple species were described in the last years. but i'm really not the inocybe expert.
